chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Whoever sweeps the mosque on Thursday and the night of Friday, and removes from it dust that is fine enough to enter the eye, Allah will forgive him."

key_terms.مَا يُذَرُّ فِي الْعَيْنِ: Fine enough to enter the eye (very fine dust)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for cleaning the mosque on Thursday night?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* underscores the spiritual merit of preparing the mosque for the congregational Friday prayer by removing dust, linking physical cleanliness to divine forgiveness. It reflects the broader Shia emphasis on the sanctity of worship spaces and the ritual purity required for communal prayers, particularly in anticipation of the Imam or the Prophet's presence.
